list_proposals.description: New lists and changes to lists that an agent proposed; each changes nothing until a human approves it

lists.description: Named values that conditions refer to with { list = "name" }, so several rules share one copy

Actions.description:
What a rule does, each at most once and in any order: flags and tags are set before a move, and a delete wins over
the rest

after.description:
Waits before the other actions run: a span such as 15min or 3d after the message arrived, "read" until it is
read, or a list of them, whichever comes first. Until then notify and stop already apply

archive.description: true moves the message to the server's Archive folder

delete.description: true backs the message up as .eml locally, then removes it from the server; later rules don't run

flagged.description: true flags the message, false unflags it

forward.description:
Sends the message on to other addresses, new mail only and once you approved the rule in Postvak; runs before
the other actions

junk.description:
true tags the message $Junk, which trains server spam filters, and moves it to the server's Junk folder; other
actions but delete don't run

move.description:
Moves the message to this folder, creating it if needed; {subaddress} is the +tag of your address the message
was sent to, and without a tag of letters, digits, - and _ the message is not moved

notify.description: true notifies even when the message was moved, false never notifies; the first matching rule that says wins

read.description: true marks the message read, false unread

stop.description: true: later rules don't run for this message

tag.description: Adds this IMAP keyword, or each of a list; Thunderbird shows them as tags (e.g. $label1)

AttachmentMatch.description: Attachments that match every condition given; at least one

type.description: A MIME type such as application/pdf, or application/* for any subtype

Attachments.description: true forwards every attachment, false none, a table those that match all its conditions

Domain.description: A domain such as example.com, or { list = "name" } for every domain of that list

Forward.description:
Sends the message on through the account's SMTP server. Only new mail, and only once you approved the rule in
Postvak: any change to the rule needs a new approval

as.description: inline (default): the text below a header block, attachments attached again; attachment: the original whole

attachments.description: Which attachments go along with an inline forward: true (default) all, false none, or a table naming them

from.description:
Your address to send as: the account's or one an alias matches; needs the rule's account. Default the address of
yours the message was sent to, else the account's

max_size.description:
When the message is larger: a size such as 10MB, or { limit = "10MB", over = "strip" }. skip (default) does not
forward it, strip forwards it without attachments. Default limit 25MB or the server's own

rate.description: Forwards per hour, at most; more pauses the rule until you approve it again. Default 20

subject_prefix.description:
Put before the subject unless it already starts with a forward prefix; may be empty; {subaddress} as in move.
Default "Fwd: "

ListProposal.description: A new list, or a change to one, that an agent proposed; it changes nothing until a human approves it

name.description: The list it adds or changes

proposed_by.description: Who proposed it; set by `rules propose`

ListRef.description: The domains of a list in [lists]

alias.description:
An address among the recipients (To, Cc or Delivered-To) is this alias; * matches any run of characters, and
nothing else is special: it is no regex

any.description: Holds when at least one entry holds; an entry holds when all its conditions do

arrived_days.description:
Arrived on one of these local weekdays: mon-fri, sat,sun or fri-mon, each day by its first three letters or in
full

arrived_hours.description:
Arrived between these local times, such as 09:00-18:00, the end not included; 22:00-07:00 wraps past midnight.
Read apart from arrived_days: with fri, mail from Friday 03:00 matches and from Saturday 03:00 does not

attachment.description: An attachment's file name; any attachment may match

authenticated.description: An Authentication-Results header from a server in the account's trusted_authserv_ids says DMARC passed for the From domain, or without a DMARC verdict, DKIM passed for a domain aligned with it; never true without that list

body.description: The plain-text body; HTML mail is converted

from_domain.description: The From address's domain or any subdomain of it, never the display name; a list matches any of them

from_name.description: A From display name, unquoted, never the address; a From without one never matches

has_attachment.description:
Has an attachment (true) or none (false): a named part that is not body text, inline images and the parts of a
forwarded message included

has_part.description:
Has a part of this MIME type, such as text/calendar, or of any subtype with *, such as application/*;
case-insensitive

header.description:
Headers by name, such as List-Id, each with its own text condition; every header named must match. Of a repeated
header only the last copy counts, the one nearest the body

larger_than.description: Larger than this size, e.g. 500KB, 5MB; a bare number is bytes and 1KB is 1024 bytes

none.description: Holds when no entry holds; an entry holds when all its conditions do

older_than.description: Arrived at least this long ago: 30min, 1h, 2d, 3w, 6mo or 1y; a bare m is refused as ambiguous

tag.description: Carries this IMAP keyword, which Thunderbird shows as a tag (e.g. $label1); case-insensitive

to_domain.description: The domain, or any subdomain, of an address in the To header, not Cc; a list matches any of them

to_me.description: Your address or an alias is among the recipients: To, Cc or Delivered-To

younger_than.description: Arrived less than this long ago, the opposite of older_than: holds mail back while it is new

MaxSize.description: A size such as 10MB, or a table with limit and over

NamedList.description:
Domains for from_domain and to_domain, or a text condition (one of contains, equals, regex) for from, from_name, to,
cc, subject, body, attachment and header; a list cannot refer to another list

OneOrMany.description: One value, or a list of them

OneOrMany2.description: One value, or a list of them

account.description: Only for this account; default all accounts

actions.description: What to do; at least one

enabled.description: Disabled rules are skipped; proposals start disabled

folder.description: The folder the rule watches; default INBOX

match.description: Conditions that must all hold; at least one

name.description: Unique name; renaming a rule restarts its clock

proposed_by.description: Who proposed the rule; set by `rules propose` and removed when a human approves it

replaces.description: The rule this proposal changes once approved; set by `rules propose --edit`

limit.description: A size such as 10MB; default 25MB or the server's own

over.description: skip: not forwarded; strip: forwarded without its attachments

TextMatch.description: Exactly one of contains, equals, regex, list

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring; a list matches any of them

equals.description: The whole value, case-insensitive; on from, to and cc also any single address; a list matches any of them

list.description: The name of a text list in [lists], whose condition this is

regex.description: Rust regex syntax, case-insensitive like the others; (?-i) makes it case-sensitive
